scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ytpa/shared && npm run build --workspace @ytpa/api && npm run build --workspace @ytpa/media && npm run build --workspace @ytpa/web
scripts.build:backend: npm run build --workspace @ytpa/shared && npm run build --workspace @ytpa/api && npm run build --workspace @ytpa/media
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @ytpa/shared && npm run dev --workspace @ytpa/api
scripts.dev:backend: node tools/run-services.mjs dev shared api media
scripts.dev:backend:cache: node tools/run-services.mjs dev --with-cache shared api media
scripts.dev:media: npm run build --workspace @ytpa/shared && npm run dev --workspace @ytpa/media
scripts.dev:all: node tools/run-services.mjs dev shared api media web
scripts.dev:all:cache: node tools/run-services.mjs dev --with-cache shared api media web
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace @ytpa/shared && npm run check --workspace @ytpa/api && npm run check --workspace @ytpa/media && npm run check --workspace @ytpa/web
scripts.start:all: node tools/run-services.mjs start api media web
scripts.start:all:cache: node tools/run-services.mjs start --with-cache api media web
scripts.prod:backend: npm run build:backend && node tools/run-services.mjs start api media
scripts.prod:backend:cache: npm run build:backend && node tools/run-services.mjs start --with-cache api media
scripts.prod:all: npm run build && node tools/run-services.mjs start api media web
scripts.prod:all:cache: npm run build && node tools/run-services.mjs start --with-cache api media web
